The polygon renders ambiguously at low resolution. Let me measure the actual polygon edges precisely against the labelled dimensions.



import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from fractions import Fraction as F

p = r"C:\Users\Nam\Desktop\AI agent\benchmarks\gaia\data\attachments\6359a0b1-8f7b-499b-9336-840f9ab90688.png"
a = np.array(Image.open(p).convert("RGB")).astype(int)
R, G, B = a[:, :, 0], a[:, :, 1], a[:, :, 2]
green = (G > 120) & (R < 120) & (B < 120)

# exact boundary scan lines (all transitions, including notches)
for y in [55, 100, 150, 175, 185, 200, 215, 225, 250, 275, 285, 320, 355]:
    xs = np.where(green[y])[0]
    if len(xs) == 0:
        print("y", y, "empty"); continue
    # split into runs
    runs = []
    s = xs[0]; prev = xs[0]
    for x in xs[1:]:
        if x != prev + 1:
            runs.append((int(s), int(prev))); s = x
        prev = x
    runs.append((int(s), int(prev)))
    print("y", y, "runs", runs)

print()
for x in [30, 100, 150, 200, 220, 235, 250, 275, 280]:
    ys = np.where(green[:, x])[0]
    if len(ys) == 0:
        print("x", x, "empty"); continue
    runs = []
    s = ys[0]; prev = ys[0]
    for y in ys[1:]:
        if y != prev + 1:
            runs.append((int(s), int(prev))); s = y
        prev = y
    runs.append((int(s), int(prev)))
    print("x", x, "runs", runs)
